scope: Unreleased UI branding source; not installed or published as a replacement for 0.2.1
method: Verified DEB extracted and mounted at normal paths in a private bubblewrap filesystem view. Isolated profiles, native Wayland, temporary Qt observer/controller via LD_PRELOAD. No focus shim or warning filter. Dialog images are Qt widget renders.
scenarios: Open About and inspect project and contribution link
Open Authors and License tabs; compare full displayed texts with installed baseline
Open Remux and inspect source column
Open Safe Mode restart confirmation and cancel
Close main window and check exit status and logs
limitations: Only English and German dialogs were exercised natively; all 77 frontend locale catalogues were statically audited.
This branding check does not retest streaming, recording, authentication, or other package formats.

en-US.restartText: Do you want to restart Penguin Studio in Safe Mode (third-party plugins, scripting, and WebSockets disabled)?

de-DE.restartText: Möchten Sie Penguin Studio im abgesicherten Modus (mit deaktivierten Drittanbieter-Plugins, Skripten und WebSockets) neu starten?
